verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot delivers AI-generated code suggestions, agentic edits, autofix, and PR review insights (github-docs-1,2,5,9,13,14), showing genuine AI-generated insights within the product. However, evidence is vendor-doc only for these features, with community feedback focused on reliability/trust issues rather than confirming quality of AI insights, and one early hands-on review is mixed ('guesses right about one in ten times') suggesting real-world caveats.
